description: Repo-scale (c-jobqueue): add pagination to scheduler_history_page that must compose with the existing state filter, not bypass it
prompts: Add `int scheduler_history_page(const Scheduler *s, int has_filter, JobState filter_state, int page, int page_size, Job *out_jobs, int *out_total)` to scheduler.h/scheduler.c. `has_filter`/`filter_state` optionally restrict to one JobState (e.g. JOB_DONE or JOB_FAILED) among the scheduler's history entries. `page` (1-based) and `page_size` must both be positive - return -1 otherwise. It writes up to `page_size` matching Job structs into caller-allocated `out_jobs`, writes the count of ALL matching history entries (not just the page) to `*out_total`, and returns how many it actually wrote. Pagination must be applied AFTER the state filter, not before - `*out_total` must reflect the filtered count, and the written jobs must be the correct page of the FILTERED set, not a page of the raw history array filtered down afterward.
name: add_c_jobqueue_history_pagination
